game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp, a caravan camp: the caravan guide must hold off dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Caravan Camp: a caravan camp
core_gameplay_loop: In Caravan Camp, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Then check clues and advance.
player_objective: Protect the water well from dust devils in Caravan Camp: keep clues above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 3, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes
